environment_release_audit.pre_existing_partial_declaration: Poincare.Longrun.Surgery.SurgeryChain.append._unsafe_rec (present in the D6 scaffold; noted, not failed)

analytic_boundaries: The sharpened theorems are statements about the finite one-variable Gibbs term and the finite Perelman sum, not Perelman's F-functional or a Ricci flow.
The curvature data c is an abstract real vector; 1 ≤ c i is the finite analogue of a scalar-curvature lower bound and remains an explicit hypothesis.
At c = 1 the derivative vanishes at the isolated flat spot x = 1; strict antitonicity is proved by gluing the two one-sided strict results, so no global strict derivative sign is hidden.
The strict decrease retains 0 < h and 0 < F.eval (traj n) i; the audit's strict_step_needs_pos_step and strict_step_needs_pos_reaction show both are necessary.
The D2 ReactionField sign condition F.eval ≥ 0 is a structure field, not a hidden assumption; dropping it is refuted by the audit's negative-reaction counterexamples.
The certificate instantiations are honest inhabitants of the D3 structures; strictness is a separate addendum because it holds only at strictly positive-reaction steps.

No manifold-level, continuous-Perelman, kappa-noncollapsing, surgery or Poincare claim is made; the approximation boundary remains the explicit hypothesis interface of Poincare.Longrun.Evolution.Bridge.

repair.cause: The harness compile gate (longrun/bin/dispatch_loop.py::compile_gate) runs `lake env lean <absolute .lean file>` with cwd = the worktree root. The D6 scaffold keeps lakefile.toml / lean-toolchain / .lake under release/, and the longrun elan installation has no default toolchain, so elan aborted before elaboration with `no default toolchain configured`; all 71 .lean files exited 1 for this environmental reason, not because of a proof failure.
repair.fix: Added four root-level shim files (no mathematical file changed): lean-toolchain; lakefile.toml with packagesDir = .lake/packages and a mathlib require (scope leanprover-community, rev master); lake-manifest.json copied byte-for-byte from release/lake-manifest.json; and a .lake -> release/.lake symlink. The shim only re-exposes the prebuilt release/.lake tree; it rebuilds and re-fetches nothing and changes no imported module.
